title: Integrative Multiomics and Single-cell Profiling Identify Cell-type-resolved Inflammatory Drivers in Symptomatic Irreversible Pulpitis
html: Symptomatic irreversible pulpitis (SIP) is a painful dental condition often diagnosed on the basis of subjective pain reports, which are frequently vague and poorly localized, leading to diagnostic uncertainty and potential overtreatment. Our study integrated multiomics data to identify objective molecular signatures related to pulp inflammation and pain modulation.
